text:
alice_support: Hey team, customer (internal staging) reporting big cross-region latency spikes. They claim they send X-Region: us-west but requests land in eu-west. Ticket says ~300ms extra RTT. 

ben_runtime: :eyes: Do we have a request example + headers? Could be LB mutation.

alice_support: Pasting the curl they used (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer redacted' \
  -H 'X-Region: us-west' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

alice_support: They also sent a HAR. In our edge logs we see: `x-region: ""` (empty string) and a cookie `region_pref=; Path=/;` so somehow an empty region cookie ends up present.

dave_network: That smells like a frontend LB rewrite. We recently enabled a sticky-cookie feature on the ingress. Could the LB be copying X-Region into a cookie but not preserving empty values correctly?

ben_runtime: Router precedence: we treat explicit header X-Region > cookie region_pref > geolocation. But there is a known edge case where an empty cookie was considered "present" and took precedence.

alice_support: Customer timeline: they started rolling out an AB test of a proxy that strips headers; they said they didn't modify region header though.

tina_ops: Can we reproduce quickly? I can simulate with curl and an ingress that adds an empty cookie.

ben_runtime: Repro steps I'll try locally:
1) curl with X-Region: us-west and no cookies -> route to us-west edge OK
2) curl with X-Region: us-west plus cookie "region_pref=" -> routes to eu-west (bad)

ben_runtime: Quick logs from router decision (debug):
```
[router] incoming: X-Region="us-west", Cookie: region_pref=""
[router] cookie present, using cookie as region override
[router] selected_edge=eu-west
```

ben_runtime: Problem: code checks cookie existence with `if (cookie != null)` but doesn't validate non-empty string. So empty cookie overrides header.

dave_network: Confirmed. Our ingress controller (nginx-lb) sets `Set-Cookie: region_pref=;` when clearing preferences. That interacts poorly.

alice_support: Customer impact: intermittent misroutes when their proxy clears the region cookie. They get EU edge and pay cross-region latency, also some auth failures when region-specific keys used.

tina_ops: Short-term mitigation: change router precedence to prefer X-Region header if header is non-empty. Also we can add an edge filter to ignore empty region_pref cookie.

ben_runtime: I'll open a tiny patch: treat cookie as override only if `trim(cookie).length > 0`. Will add a unit test.

ben_runtime: Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/452 (WIP)

deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary on runtime-1 tomorrow 02:00 UTC (manual approval required).

alice_support: Workaround for customers: ensure their LB doesn't set empty `region_pref` cookie or strip that cookie header when forwarding. Example nginx snippet: 
```nginx
proxy_set_header Cookie $http_cookie;
# drop empty region_pref cookie
proxy_set_header Cookie "${http_cookie}";
if ($http_cookie ~* "region_pref=") {
  proxy_set_header Cookie $http_cookie;
}
# simpler: use proxy_cookie_flags/ignore logic in ingress to not forward blank values
```

dave_network: I'll add a filter in our ingress config to drop `region_pref` cookies with empty values. Rolling change in 15m.

tina_ops: I deployed a quick canary nginx config to staging that strips empty region_pref. Repro attempt returns to us-west.

ben_runtime: Great. I'll get the PR ready for review and include a migration note: router will ignore empty region cookie as of next release.

alice_support: Notifying the customer with repro steps and temporary workaround (remove empty cookie).

tina_ops: Follow-up: after deploy, monitor support channel for any residual misroutes for 2 hours.

ben_runtime: Plan: merge PR, canary deploy, monitor. If stable, promote to prod. Expected timeline: canary tonight, prod tomorrow morning UTC.

alice_support: Thanks all — closing internal loop once prod is green. :thumbsup:
